source_name: UkrCard — careers page
why_relevant: UkrCard is a domestic interbank processing/switch operator; its role requirements explicitly cite banking and card technologies, testing of web services and processing components — direct disclosure of the platform components in use.

source_name: UPC (Ukrainian Processing Center) corporate site and LinkedIn page
why_relevant: 500+ staff processor serving banks in ~16 CEE countries; company news and LinkedIn announcements name bank clients, launched services (3DS, tokenisation, wallets, ATM/POS acquiring) and project milestones — indirect disclosure of card processing footprint and volumes.

source_name: Djinni.co — IT job marketplace (fintech/payments filters)
why_relevant: Dominant Ukrainian dev-hiring marketplace; anonymised postings still expose domain ('payments', 'acquiring', 'card processing'), stack and seniority mix, and Djinni's own annual analytics posts quantify hiring volumes by domain — a macro hiring indicator for the fintech segment.

source_name: Work.ua resume database (payments/ATM specialists)
why_relevant: Public CVs of Ukrainian card/EMV/ATM specialists describe employer projects in detail — e.g. legacy CMS to Way4 migrations, Digital Payments Hub architecture, EMV/POS certification work — naming systems and timelines that no company announced. Extremely high signal, but personal data.

source_name: OpenWay Group — Way4 product and customer pages
why_relevant: Core card-platform vendor whose Ukrainian installed base (e.g. Oschadbank's processing centre on Way4) is disclosed via product, case-study and press pages; vendor material is a reliable pointer to which UA banks run which processing stack, complementing hiring signals.

source_name: Rockpay and RENOME SMART — employer vacancy footprints (cash/ATM infrastructure)
why_relevant: Non-bank actors appearing repeatedly in ATM/terminal-engineer vacancies: Rockpay (self-described next-generation cash replenishment infrastructure) and RENOME SMART (banking technology product company). Their regional hiring is a direct proxy for cash-handling/self-service device deployment outside the big banks.

source_name: IT Ukraine Association — events calendar
why_relevant: Industry-body calendar that cross-lists fintech/payments forums; useful as a redundant pointer to catch events not covered by DOU or psm7.

source_name: НБУ — Реєстрація платіжних систем, учасників платіжних систем та технологічних операторів платіжних послуг (Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури)
why_relevant: Central NBU page for the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури — enumerates registered payment systems, their participants, technological operators of payment services and payment infrastructure service operators. It is the authoritative population list of regulated payment actors in Ukraine and the natural seed for exhaustive actor scouting; counts and status changes are themselves market statistics.

source_name: НБУ — Ліцензування небанківських установ / Licensing Nonbank Institutions
why_relevant: Hub describing authorisation of non-bank financial payment service providers, e-money issuers and limited payment service providers under Resolution No. 217 of 07.10.2022; points to the licence lists that define the non-bank PSP population.

source_name: НБУ — Пошук небанківських установ (Реєстри та переліки небанківських фінансових установ)
why_relevant: Searchable registers/lists of non-bank financial institutions — фінансові компанії, ломбарди, кредитні спілки, страховики, небанківські фінансові групи. Financial companies are the legal shell for many payment/e-money/money-transfer actors, so this is the enumeration layer for non-bank payments.

source_name: КІС НБУ — Комплексна інформаційна система Національного банку (kis.bank.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Reported by multiple secondary sources as the NBU system exposing the Державний реєстр фінансових установ (non-bank register launched July 2020). Likely the query backend behind the public register search, so potentially a structured/queryable source of the regulated-entity population.

source_name: Державний реєстр банків — довідник банківських установ, що мають банківську ліцензію (НБУ)
why_relevant: Open-data resource carrying State Register of Banks content: banks holding a licence, banks in liquidation, accredited branches and separate subdivisions, in XLS. Gives the exact bank population and its time series of status changes — a genuine market statistic (bank count, branch count) and the pointer set for bank-level scouting.

source_name: НБУ Відкриті дані / OpenData REST API (NBUStatService довідники)
why_relevant: NBU's own open-data hub and REST API. Documented endpoints include statdirectory reference books and the bank/branch directory (GET XML/JSON, filterable by GLMFO bank code, subdivision type and date), i.e. the register of banks and their outlets as a programmable feed rather than a web page.

source_name: НБУ — Реєстр показників звітності учасників ринку небанківських фінансових послуг
why_relevant: Register of reporting indicators for non-bank market participants — a metadata register that maps which entities report which indicators. Bridges the licence-register population to actual reported payment/market statistics, so it tells a collector exactly which statistical series exist per actor type.

source_name: НБУ — перелік системно важливих, соціально важливих та важливих платіжних систем і важливих технологічних операторів
why_relevant: Annually published designation list naming the systemically/socially important payment systems and important payment-service technology operators (e.g. СЕП, Visa, Mastercard, PrivatMoney, NovaPay, «Фінансовий світ», ACD Processing, Ukrainian Processing Center, TAS Link). A short, ranked, named list of the actors that actually move volume — high-signal for prioritising later scouting.

source_name: НБУ — Open Banking (реєстр/авторизація TPP: AISP та PISP)
why_relevant: Open banking went live 1 August 2025; TPPs providing account-information (AIS) and payment-initiation (PIS) services must be authorised by the NBU. The emerging authorised-TPP list is a new, fast-changing register segment that defines the fintech population.

source_name: Реєстр учасників Фонду гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб (відкриті дані)
why_relevant: Machine-readable register of DGF member banks. Because membership is automatic on receipt of a banking licence, this is an independent cross-check on the State Register of Banks and a clean time series of bank entry/exit.

source_name: ФГВФО — архів переліку банків-учасників Фонду
why_relevant: Dated historical snapshots of the member-bank list, which is exactly what is needed to reconstruct bank-population history without having to have been collecting snapshots yourself.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр юридичних осіб, ФОП та громадських формувань (ЄДР) — відкриті дані
why_relevant: The national company register in bulk open-data form, including founders and кінцеві бенефіціарні власники. Access as open data was restored in January 2026 after the wartime suspension (defence-sector data still restricted). This is the identity/ownership backbone for every licensed bank, PSP and financial company found in the NBU registers, joined by EDRPOU code.

source_name: Opendatabot — Державний реєстр фінансових установ / фінансові ліцензії
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator republishing the State Register of Financial Institutions and licence data in a searchable, API-accessible form — far easier to harvest than the bot-defended regulator site, and useful as a redundancy/cross-check layer.

source_name: YouControl — досьє компаній та джерела даних
why_relevant: Aggregates 180+ Ukrainian state sources into company dossiers (ownership, beneficiaries, connections, licences). Its public sources page is itself a pointer inventory — a shortcut to discovering registers this cell has not yet enumerated.

source_name: Clarity Project — перевірка контрагента за ЄДРПОУ
why_relevant: Free-tier register aggregator combining ЄДР data, КВЕД codes, related persons and procurement links. Useful for cheap bulk enrichment of licensed-entity lists and for spotting corporate groups behind multiple licences.

source_name: НКЦПФР — Державний реєстр фінансових установ (небанківські фінустанови під наглядом Комісії)
why_relevant: Second regulator maintaining a segment of the State Register of Financial Institutions (capital-market entities). Needed for completeness: the regulated-financial-actor population in Ukraine is split between the NBU and the NSSMC.

source_name: regulation.gov.ua — каталог функцій та дозволів: «веде реєстр платіжних систем, систем розрахунків, учасників цих систем та операторів послуг платіжної інфраструктури»
why_relevant: State catalogue of regulatory functions and permits: it names, in official wording, which register each authority is legally obliged to maintain. An excellent meta-pointer for discovering registers that exist by law but are poorly surfaced on regulator websites.

source_name: Положення про порядок здійснення авторизації діяльності надавачів фінансових платіжних послуг (Постанова Правління НБУ № 217 від 07.10.2022) та Положення про реєстрацію платіжних систем (z0348-14)
why_relevant: The legal instruments that define what the registers must contain, the nine statutory categories of payment service provider, and the fields recorded on authorisation. Essential for building a correct schema and for knowing which register segments must exist.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua — довідник банківських установ та довідник підрозділів небанківських фінустанов з генеральними ліцензіями на обмін валют (архівний сайт НБУ)
why_relevant: Legacy NBU site still serving the bank directory by MFO code and the directory of non-bank FX-exchange outlets. Valuable for historical continuity of the register and for outlet-level (branch/exchange point) geography, which underpins cash-usage and physical-network analysis.

source_name: Доступ до правди — запити на публічну інформацію до НБУ (напр. «Довідник банків України»)
why_relevant: FOI platform whose published request threads contain NBU's own answers about where register data lives and in what format — and provides a legal channel (запит на публічну інформацію) to obtain register extracts that are not published online.
